grafite_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Graphite/StatsD server to send metrics to.

grafite_port.description: Port number of the Graphite plaintext receiver (typically 2003) or StatsD UDP port (typically 8125).

grafite_prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to all metric keys (e.g., 'ejabberd.prod.node1').

grafite_interval.description: Interval in seconds between metric collection and sending to Graphite.

grafite_tags.description: Static tags to attach to every metric (e.g., environment, datacenter, service).

grafite_enabled_stats.description: List of ejabberd statistics to collect and export. See ejabberd_mod_grafite docs for valid stat names.

items.description: Name of an ejabberd stat to expose (e.g., 'active_users', 'messages_sent', 'online_nodes').
